title: Maintain keyed agent harness rows in canonical order
changes: Adds an opt-in smallclaims View for observed agent harness rows.
Maintains canonical ordered subtree summaries for sparse optional fields, legacy status episodes and native readiness fences.
Exposes certified keyed reads without a canonical-history fallback; production registry and collection activation remain separate.

validation.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache-rustc RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS=4 cargo test -p st3 --lib ordered_agent -j 6 -- --test-threads=4 --nocapture
controls: Sparse named and unnamed observations, optional nulls, approval blocks, runtime resets.
Native auth, update, admission and attachment fences with mixed status stamps.
Canonical ties, permuted replication and duplicate admission.
Transaction rollback, pending sources, retained-original repair, body mutation and deleted-source fencing.
Bare-body legacy and nontext incarnation observations.
Read growth control: 5 statements / 92 VM steps at 32 and 256 observations.

limits: Harness source kernel only: no default production registration or reader activation.
Declaration, owner, work queue, placement, faults, person authorization and captured-time card overlays need complete independent dependency coverage before full card certification.
Existing populated-store installation, checkpoint restoration and historical source roots require an explicit source installer; unsupported source mutations fence output.
